diffs.diff: CO ppm: datasheet reading gives 0.1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The Winsen ZE07-CO manual states 'Gas concentration value = (High Byte*256+Low Byte) x 0.1' (resolution 0.1 ppm), and the model already applies exactly this 0.1 ppm/count scale in sim.uartStream (control 'value', bits 16, scale 0.1) and in the driver (concentration = (CH*256 + CL) x 0.1 ppm); the gate reports 'none' only because it does not read uartStream conversions.
